items.title: Enhance Connectivity Information
items.rationale: To provide users with comprehensive tips for maximizing cellular connectivity, which is crucial for camera performance.
items.overreach_check: No active drafts or sensitive information affected.
items.proposed_content:
### Connectivity and Signal Reliability (Source-Backed Framing)
- When discussing connectivity in drafts, prefer procedural guidance over hard range promises.
- Emphasize setup variables that are repeatedly supported by source notes: antenna placement height, topography effects, and extension options.
- Treat specific mileage or percentage outcomes as confirm-required unless already validated in approved website/internal docs.

items.title: Add Troubleshooting Tips for Latch System
items.rationale: To ensure users can effectively troubleshoot issues with the latch system, enhancing user experience and operational reliability.
items.overreach_check: No active drafts or sensitive information affected.
items.proposed_content:
### Latch and Trigger Troubleshooting Emphasis
- Prioritize connection-integrity checks before making performance conclusions.
- Reuse practical troubleshooting flow in research packs and drafts: verify cable seating, verify adapter connection, and confirm trigger-path power signals where source-supported.
- Keep troubleshooting language tied to trap outcome reliability, not generic electronics advice.

items.title: Include Best Practices for Camera Setup
items.rationale: To provide users with essential setup tips that prevent damage and ensure optimal performance of the camera.
items.overreach_check: No active drafts or sensitive information affected.
items.proposed_content:
### Setup Best-Practice Language Guidance
- Prefer clear setup and handling language that helps operators avoid preventable equipment issues.
- When using setup references from source notes, keep product naming normalized to `HogEye` and frame guidance as practical field procedure.
- Encourage alignment/fit checks before forceful handling, and avoid unsourced material-performance guarantees.
